method: manual source review via the live EURES public JSON API (https://europa.eu/eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/jv/id/{source_id}): each posting fetched live from a europa.eu origin page, stored title compared against the live title, and the live body read for role confirmation before translation. Not model output. 15 of 18 candidates in this window returned HTTP 200 with exact title matches and were filled. Three postings returned HTTP 404 (dead postings) and were skipped without a fill: 36d195acc5f6fd3a (LV, UGUNSDROŠĪBAS UN CIVILĀS AIZSARDZĪBAS TEHNIĶIS); 36fa586a861a135b (DE, Lagerhelfer (m/w/d) - Dauerfrühschicht (Helfer/in - Lagerwirtschaft, Transport)); 38ce50569735e64d (DK, Medarbejder søges til takeaway-restaurant Er det dig?) - the dead-link sweep owns pruning. All fills carry expected_source_id pins (guard shipped 2026-11-22).
